observations.title: Change a player's available slots
observations.player_action: An administrator configures global slots or applies supported attribute modifiers through items/effects.
observations.outcome: Inventory, hotbar, offhand, armor or crafting availability can change per player.
conditions: The author states default installation alone appears to do nothing; configuration is required.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Effective slot attributes and native slot accessibility are the evidence; counting inventory array entries alone misrepresents usable capacity.

observations.title: Handle items occupying disabled slots
observations.player_action: Inspect a slot reduction's resulting inventory state.
observations.outcome: Disabled FakeSlots reject interaction and pre-existing contents can be thrown out; hiding the slots is a separate client option.
conditions: The underlying inventory size is technically unchanged; container replacements can affect compatibility.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Effective slot attributes and native slot accessibility are the evidence; counting inventory array entries alone misrepresents usable capacity.
